'''''Norellraptor''''' is an [[extinct]] genus of [[dromaeosaurid]] theropod dinosaur in the clade [[Microraptoria]] known from the [[Early Cretaceous]] ([[Barremian]]–[[Aptian]] ages) [[Jiufotang Formation]] of China. The genus contains a [[monotypic taxon|single species]], '''''Norellraptor barsboldi''''', known from a single complete skeleton including impressions of the plumage (specimen 130108-MHGU-F4281).<ref name="Norellraptor" />

== Description and classification ==
The complete ''Norellraptor'' specimen was found assorted with a series of plummage imprints mainly on the right humerus, synsacrum and its tail. Whilst the feathers on its humerus and synsacrum could not be analysed due to bad preservation, the tail feathers were found to have a rachis-dominated morphology. The whole skeleton measured approximately {{cvt|57|cm|ft}} long and had a moderate disarticulation of its [[shoulder girdle]]s. The specimen is believed to have been a post-juvenile upon its death. It was shown to have differing dentary crowns than those of ''[[Changyuraptor]]'', more equal second and third metatarsal lengths than ''[[Graciliraptor]]'', and a smaller pubic foot compared to the genera ''[[Hesperonychus]]'' and ''[[Sinornithosaurus]]''. The third and the fourth toes had a moderately elongated penultimate phalanx and curved [[ungual]]s. From these findings, ''Norellraptor'' was assigned to [[Microraptoria|Microraptorini]], being a sister taxon to ''[[Zhongjianosaurus]]''.<ref name="Norellraptor" />

== Etymology ==
The [[Generic name (biology)|generic name]] ''Norellraptor'' is derived from the name of [[Mark Norell|Mark Allen Norell]], a prominent vertebrate palaeontologist known for his work on non-avian dinosaurs who passed away in 2025, and from the [[Latin]] word ''raptor'', meaning thief. The [[Binomial nomenclature|specific epithet]], ''barsboldi'' honours the late [[Rinchen Barsbold]]<ref name="Norellraptor">{{Cite journal |last1=Wang |first1=Xuri |last2=Ji |first2=Yannan |last3=Cau |first3=Andrea |last4=Kundrát |first4=Martin |last5=Liu |first5=Yichuan |last6=Wang |first6=Yang |last7=Ji |first7=Qiang |date=29 September 2026 |title=Independent assembly of the flight apparatus in a non-avian dinosaur clade |journal=[[Nature Communications]] |language=en |volume=17 |issue=1 |article-number=10074 |doi=10.1038/s41467-026-77804-6 |issn=2041-1723 |doi-access=free}}</ref> a prolific Mongolian palaeontologist who also passed away the same year.

== Paleoenvironment ==
''Norellraptor'' lived in a [[Temperate rainforest|temperate forested]] environment of the Jiufotang Formation,  much like the older underlying [[Yixian Formation]]. It mainly lived alongside the [[Tyrannosauroidea|tyrannosauroid]] ''[[Sinotyrannus]]'', [[Eutriconodonta|eutriconodont]] ''[[Liaoconodon]]'', [[ceratopsia]]n ''[[Psittacosaurus]]'', and a wide assortment of [[Enantiornithes|enantiornithines]], [[Euornithes|euornithines]], and [[pterosaur]]s.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Young |first=Mark |date=9 February 2023 |title=A taxonomic revision of the Sinopterus complex (Pterosauria, Tapejaridae) from the Early Cretaceous Jehol Biota, with the new genus Huaxiadraco |url=https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9922500/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260930170017/https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9922500/ |archive-date=30 September 2026 |access-date=30 September 2026 |website=[[PubMedCentral]]}}</ref>
